scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.start:isolated: pnpm run kill-ports && concurrently "dotenv -e ./artifacts/api-server/.env.local -- cmd /c pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts run mcp-local" "dotenv -e ./artifacts/api-server/.env.local -- cmd /c pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run dev" "dotenv -e ./artifacts/strategy-engine/.env.local -- cmd /c pnpm --filter @workspace/strategy-engine run dev"
scripts.start:full: pnpm run kill-ports && dotenv -e ./artifacts/api-server/.env.local -- npx pnpm --filter @workspace/db run push && concurrently "dotenv -e ./artifacts/api-server/.env.local -- cmd /c pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts run mcp-local" "dotenv -e ./artifacts/api-server/.env.local -- cmd /c pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run dev" "dotenv -e ./artifacts/strategy-engine/.env.local -- cmd /c pnpm --filter @workspace/strategy-engine run dev"
